name: Bambu Lab A1 with AMS lite

source.quote: Bambu Lab A1 Technical Specification. Build Volume: 256*256*256 mm³

notes: The AMS lite feeds up to four spools into the one nozzle (Bambu Lab's AMS lite store page, https://us.store.bambulab.com/products/ams-lite, which allows one AMS lite per A1); it does not change the build volume.
